crons.prompt:
Check Slack for new messages: bash .claude/skills/slack-bot/check-slack.sh

If there are no messages, do nothing.

If there ARE messages: read each message and reply in character (per your IDENTITY.md and SOUL.md). If the message contains feedback about your behavior (correction or confirmation), apply the Feedback Loop from CLAUDE.md.

Run bash scripts/mark-alive.sh first (liveness signal). Then: Read HEARTBEAT.md and perform each task listed. Also read today's memory file at memory/{today's date}.md for context. Update the memory file with anything notable.
